prompt: byte-identical to the local LLaVA path (vlm_boxes.PROMPT)
coordinate_convention: 0-1000 normalised; verified against cached LLaVA boxes (mean IoU 0.65 after scaling, 0.0 unscaled)

sampling.scope: seeded 2,000-expression samples of the official val records (full splits not evaluated under GLM: API budget discipline, operator note 2026-10-09); sampled records files: exp/out_extreme/records_<ds>_glm2000.jsonl
sampling.latency: ~7.3 s/query (thinking model, ~700 completion tokens); 2.2-2.5 queries/s at 8-10 concurrent workers
sampling.cache_reconciliation: 6,000 rows -> 5,960 per-dataset unique (image, sentence) pairs; 41 of them recur across datasets (global key) -> 5,919 unique; 5 persistent failures -> 5,914 cached responses; per-dataset coverage 1999/1996/2000 = 99.95/99.8/100.0%
sampling.why_sampled: the binding constraint is the shared API budget (operator note 2026-10-09), not wall-clock: at the recorded 2.2-2.5 queries/s the full 26,488-expression set would be ~3 hours; n=2,000/dataset keeps the paired comparison well-powered at a fraction of the token cost
sampling.paired_stats: paired bootstrap (4,000 resamples, seed 0) on the per-record IoU difference, n=2,000 rows per dataset: refcoco -0.95 [-2.35,+0.46]; refcocoplus -1.07 [-2.51,+0.42]; refcocog -2.00 [-3.37,-0.66]; the GLM deficit is significant on refcocog and within noise on the other two (the pooled-oIoU CIs are not reported; mIoU is the headline metric)
sampling.missing_box_handling: the 5 rows whose GLM query never succeeded have no cache entry; exp40 scores such rows BOX-FREE (the released-score top candidate, the same branch as the ctrl_no_box control) - not with a LLaVA fallback, so the GLM arm is not flattered by the missing rows; the LLaVA arm has 100% coverage on the same rows

components: with this swap the comparison is component-matched to GLOD-RIS: same SAM ViT-H proposals, same CLIP ViT-B/16 scoring, same MLLM (GLM-4.1V); only the selection rule differs

refcoco.note: identical rows for both box sources; only the box cache differs (exp40 --box-source glm|llava); aligned protocol (pooled oIoU)

refcocoplus.note: identical rows for both box sources; only the box cache differs (exp40 --box-source glm|llava); aligned protocol (pooled oIoU)

refcocog.note: identical rows for both box sources; only the box cache differs (exp40 --box-source glm|llava); aligned protocol (pooled oIoU)

outcome: GLM boxes land slightly below the local LLaVA prior on all three datasets (deltas -0.95/-1.07/-2.00 mIoU) while the pipeline stays far above the GLOD-RIS published rows even with the GLM boxes
prompt_caveat: component-matched means same MLLM weights (GLM-4.1V-Thinking-Flash) used inside OUR shipped path with the SAME prompt template as the LLaVA arm, as the operator instruction prescribes; it is not GLOD-RIS's internal prompting or usage, so the comparison against their published rows remains cross-paper (caveat unchanged)
